name: Gmina Opoczno (Poland)
description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly, dark red below at the hoist and white above at the fly, the white charged with the gmina arms.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: divided diagonally dark red and white
